sahneler.metin: A fire started on a US Navy assault ship docked in San Diego.
It spread for days, and dozens of sailors and civilians were injured.
The fire began on a lower vehicle deck.
It took four days to put out.
A sailor charged with arson was acquitted.

aciklama:
Bonhomme Richard burned for four days in San Diego. The cause: a fire in a ship under maintenance spreading while defenses were degraded.

#shorts #engineering #firesafety
